name: Pork grilled in leaves
summary: Nhứa phò is minced pork shoulder, lightly seasoned, wrapped in many layers of leaf, and grilled over charcoal. The meat turns yellow and sweet while the outer leaf dries without burning through.
taste: The culture desk says the seasoning and the sweet, deep pork meet, and that the cooked meat is yellow, with the outer leaf dry rather than burnt through.
howToEat: Mince pork shoulder, season it without covering the pork, wrap it in many layers of leaf, and grill it over charcoal until the meat is even and yellow and the outer leaf is dry.
Eat it from the leaf, hot.
seoTitle: Nhua pho in Dien Bien Phu — pork grilled in leaves
seoDescription: Nhứa phò is minced pork shoulder, lightly seasoned, wrapped in many layers of leaf, and grilled over charcoal.
